trips.title: Nepal Trip from Ranchi
trips.summary: A 5-day group trip from Ranchi to Nepal: Pokhara's lake and sunrise points, the Manakamana cable car, and Kathmandu's temples and stupas, with a Lavigo trip leader throughout.

itinerary.title: Ranchi → Raxaul → Pokhara
itinerary.text: Cross the border at Birgunj, drive up to Pokhara, evening by the lake.

itinerary.title: Pokhara sightseeing
itinerary.text: Sunrise point, Phewa Lake boating, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave.

itinerary.title: Pokhara → Manakamana → Kathmandu
itinerary.text: Cable car to Manakamana temple, then on to Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu sightseeing
itinerary.text: Pashupatinath, Boudhanath, Swayambhunath, evening in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu → Raxaul → Ranchi
itinerary.text: Drive back to the border and the journey home.

faqs.q: What is included in the Nepal trip from Ranchi?
faqs.a: The inclusions are listed on this page: hotel stays, the meals mentioned, travel on the route, sightseeing as listed and a Lavigo trip leader. Anything not listed under Included is extra.

faqs.q: How do I book and how much do I pay upfront?
faqs.a: Choose your departure, enter your details and your seats are held for you. You then confirm on WhatsApp with Lavigo and pay a 25% advance. The balance is due before you travel.

faqs.q: How long are my seats held?
faqs.a: Seats are held for 24 hours after you submit the booking form. If the advance is not paid in that time, the seats are released for other travellers.

faqs.q: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.a: All Lavigo group trips start and end in Ranchi, with a trip leader travelling with the group.
